| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| status | verified |
| tier | P0 |
| used by | C4, C2, NX |
| default mode | replay |
| fallback (two strikes) | synthetic |
| auth | bearer-token (`GFW_API_TOKEN`) |
| sign-up | https://globalfishingwatch.org/our-apis/tokens (free, non-commercial; ≤ 5 tokens/account) |
| protocol | REST |
| pagination | offset/limit with `nextOffset`; limit tested at 1000 |
| limits (documented) | 50,000 requests/day and 1,500,000/month across all tokens; exceeding blocks every token for 24 h / 30 days (HTTP 429). 4Wings: one report at a time (429), 524 after 100 s then fetch /4wings/last-report; date range ≤ 366 days |
| limits (observed) | headers x-ratelimit-daily-limit-requests: 50000, x-ratelimit-monthly-limit-requests: 1500000 (usage counters stayed 0) |
| licence / terms | CC BY-NC 4.0; non-commercial use only |
| attribution | "Powered by Global Fishing Watch." linked to https://globalfishingwatch.org (or the dataset/date-range citation form on the licence page) |
| NC? | yes |
| freshness / latency | port visits and presence ≈ 2–4 days behind (latest presence day 2026-10-21, latest transmission 2026-10-23 when probed on 2026-10-26) |
| history depth | port visits back to 2012+ (visits overlapping the window are returned, some starting 2014); presence 2012 → ~96 h ago |
| update cadence | daily |
| Bangladesh coverage | **Strong.** 1,897 port visits at `bgd-chittagong` in 90 days (1,242 cargo, 1,662 at confidence 4); cargo port time (conf 4, < 60 d) p10 32 h, p50 83 h, p90 276 h. Outer anchorage presence: 80–128 vessels/day (57–81 cargo) over 40 days, with IMO, MMSI, name, flag, type, hours and speed. |
| failure modes observed | no or bad token → 401 {"error":"invalid token"}; unknown dataset → 404; offset past the end → 201 with empty entries; POST /events answers 201, not 200 |
| quirks | timeFilterMode=OVERLAP returns visits that began years ago (one 12-year 'visit' at dock): filter by start date and duration. 1,142 of 1,159 cargo visits stop only at anchor cells (lighterage), so the start/intermediate/end anchorage `atDock` flags matter. Flags are ISO3. vessel.ssvid is the MMSI as a string. |
| mapping to canonical | port_call(method='gfw', gfw_visit_id ← port_visit.visitId, arrival_ts ← start, departure_ts ← end, dwell_h ← port_visit.durationHrs, confidence ← port_visit.confidence, stops ← start/intermediate/endAnchorage{anchorageId, atDock, lat, lon}); vessel_identity(gfw_vessel_id ← vessel.id, mmsi ← vessel.ssvid, flag_iso3); zone_presence_daily ← 4Wings presence rows |
| synthetic twin | the DS-AIS-01 twin's ground-truth port calls use the same fields; M1 DES calibrates to these quantiles |
| next | label store for C4 (point-in-time); hourly presence at HIGH resolution to segment anchorage wait vs berth time |
| raw schema | [DS-AIS-02.schema.json](../../schemas/raw/DS-AIS-02.schema.json) (inferred with genson; field profiles below) |
